messages.content: we're a bridal party — the wedding is in 3 days and we're doing our final shopping day

For your bridal party’s final shopping day, the strongest route is to stay in the Ground Floor Main Gallery and finish with the Kiosk Row for fragrance touches. That keeps your group moving efficiently between occasion-ready fashion, accessories, and perfume.

**Bridal shopping stops**
- **Zara [Ground, Main Gallery]** — Best for modern, polished pieces if you need a fast final pass on outfits or polished layers.
- **Aldo Accessories [Ground, Main Gallery]** or **PARFOIS [Ground, Main Gallery]** — Strong for elegant bags, accessories, and finishing touches for the wedding look.
- **Charles & Keith [Ground, Main Gallery]** or **NINE WEST [Ground, Main Gallery]** — Ideal if anyone in the party still needs shoes or a refined dressy accessory.
- **Swarovski [Ground, Main Gallery]** or **Tous [Ground, Main Gallery]** — Excellent for a giftable, celebratory finishing piece or a special bridal detail.
- **Ajmal Perfumes [Ground, Main Gallery]** → then **Reef Perfumes [Ground, Kiosk Row]** — A smart final stop for wedding-day fragrance shopping.
- **Ain Zain [Ground, Main Gallery]** or **Harayer [Ground, Main Gallery]** — Worth a look if you need elegant traditional pieces for the occasion.

A tidy route would be: **Zara → accessories at Aldo Accessories or PARFOIS → fragrance at Ajmal Perfumes or Reef Perfumes**.  
All of these are on the Ground Floor, so the group can move between them without losing time.

If you would like, I can turn this into a **30-minute bridal shopping route** or narrow it to **fashion, accessories, or perfume only**.

messages.content: the bride needs a special outfit — she wants something floor-length, not white, very elegant

For a floor-length, non-white, very elegant bridal outfit, **La Vallee** and **Ain Zain** are the strongest places to begin on the Ground Floor. Both suit a refined wedding look, and **La Vallee** is especially well aligned with evening wear.

**Best bridal outfit stops**
- **La Vallee [Ground, Main Gallery]** — Evening wear and elegant traditional fashion; the best first stop for a floor-length look with a polished finish.
- **Ain Zain [Ground, Main Gallery]** — Women’s abayas with fashionable, high-quality designs; ideal if the bride wants modest elegance.
- **Harayer [Ground, Main Gallery]** — Traditional wear with a Saudi design focus; worth visiting for a graceful, occasion-ready silhouette.
- **Mene Roz [Ground, Main Gallery]** — A stylish collection of fashion and lifestyle essentials; a good alternative for a refined, feminine look.
- **Seera [Ground, Main Gallery]** — Elegant women’s footwear; useful if the outfit needs a sophisticated finishing touch.
- **Swarovski [Ground, Main Gallery]** — Luxury crystal and jewellery; excellent for the final bridal accent.

A polished route would be **La Vallee → Ain Zain → Swarovski**, keeping the whole search on the Ground Floor and centred on elegant wedding pieces.

All three are easy to reach in the Main Gallery, so you can compare looks without losing time.  
If you would like, I can narrow this to **the most bridal-looking option** or add **matching shoes and jewellery** next.
